MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.threshold: Passes with a majority of Yes votes on the question, and Yes votes must also equal at least 30% of all ballots cast.

questions.title: Expanding the Public Records Law
questions.yes: Makes most records of the governor's office and the Legislature public, with exemptions for policy development and certain constituent communications.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST · AP has called it, passes

questions.title: Collective bargaining for public defenders
questions.yes: Lets employees of the Committee for Public Counsel Services (state public defenders) form a union and bargain collectively.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST

questions.title: State primary elections
questions.yes: Replaces party primaries for state offices with one all-party primary; the top two finishers advance to November.

questions.title: Election Day registration
questions.yes: Lets residents register or update their registration on Election Day with proof of residency and an oath.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST

questions.title: State revenue limit and rebate
questions.yes: Changes the state tax revenue cap formula and refunds revenue above the limit, starting July 1, 2027.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST

questions.title: Natural resource conservation fund
questions.yes: Creates a "Nature for All" fund for land conservation and recreation, paid from a small share of sales tax.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST

questions.title: Single-family homes on smaller lots
questions.yes: Lets towns allow single-family homes on residential lots of at least 5,000 sq ft with 50 ft of frontage and public water and sewer.

result.reporting: 45.0% of precincts · as of 12:58:04 AM EST

questions.title: Prohibit retail sale of recreational marijuana
questions.yes: Repeals the laws allowing recreational marijuana sales and home growing; medical marijuana and small-amount possession stay legal.

questions.title: Firearms regulation (referendum on the 2024 law)
questions.yes: A referendum on the 2024 gun law. BU Today reports a Yes vote keeps the law in place; Boston.com words it as a repeal question. Check the official guide before relying on this one.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.threshold: Each bond passes with a simple majority of those voting on it. Rhode Island has not rejected a bond question since 2006.

questions.title: Higher education facilities bond
questions.yes: Funds a health building at URI, a workforce innovation center at CCRI Warwick, and a student success center at Rhode Island College.

questions.title: Housing development bond
questions.yes: Funds residential development to increase and preserve affordable, accessible housing.

questions.title: Economic and infrastructure development bond
questions.yes: Funds industrial site preparation, Quonset and I-95 district infrastructure, ocean industry infrastructure and life sciences jobs.

questions.title: Environment and watershed protection bond
questions.yes: Funds local water infrastructure aid, recreation facility renovation and Narragansett Bay restoration.

questions.title: Historical center and cultural grants bond
questions.yes: Funds matching historic preservation grants and a new Rhode Island State History Center.
